steps: Confirm the named IngressClass controller and the backend Service and Pod TLS capability with their owners; the observed annotation alone does not prove encrypted traffic.

Plan migration to a supported Ingress or Gateway controller, preserving tested HTTPS backend behavior. If an existing ingress-nginx deployment must remain temporarily, review the migration window and declare backend-protocol HTTPS or GRPCS only after the backend serves TLS.
Verify the replacement controller configuration and actual client-to-backend TLS behavior in a controlled environment; restore the previous owner-approved manifest if the migration disrupts traffic.
k8s_ingress_backend_https.summary: Review TLS to the backend Service and plan migration away from retired ingress-nginx.

steps: Inspect the named IngressClass and controller configuration with the owner; an absent annotation does not establish that HTTP remains enabled.

Plan migration to a supported controller and configure its approved HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect policy. During any temporary ingress-nginx operation, set force-ssl-redirect true in the owned Ingress only when compatible with its TLS route and deployment plan.
Verify observed redirect behavior and application compatibility after rollout; restore the previous owner-approved manifest if required.
k8s_ingress_ingress_redirect_http_traffi.summary: Review explicit HTTP redirect intent and migrate the retired ingress-nginx controller.

references.title: Kubernetes: Configure a Security Context for a Pod or Container

steps: Inspect the Pod and owner workload manifest for Pod-level and container-level runAsUser and the image USER; identify containers with explicit UID zero or unresolved identity.
With the workload owner, choose a nonzero UID supported by the image and filesystem permissions; set securityContext.runAsUser in the owned manifest at Pod or container scope and stage the rollout.
Verify the resulting Pod declaration and runtime identity with the owner, and roll back the manifest revision if startup or volume access fails.
k8s_pod_effective_run_as_user_nonzero.summary: Declare a compatible nonzero Linux UID for each affected Pod container.
